scope: Node event-controller tests with mocked module and transport; no browser, GPU, real network, device or LLM. Timeline values are deterministic simulation, not observed user improvement.
cases: idle-timeout: actionable feedback and retry available
total-timeout: actionable feedback and retry available
incomplete: actionable feedback and retry available
cancel during module import prevents mount
cancel and immediate reopen: stale rejection cannot unlock or overwrite new attempt
repeated page-load events do not duplicate load handlers
no preload before click; download starts before module resolves; exact prepared buffer reaches mount once
deterministic timeline: 40 ms module and 100 ms model overlap; mount at 100 ms vs serial 140 ms (simulation)
module failure aborts pending download, preserves module error, and allows successful retry
download failure is visible without waiting for module; late module resolution cannot mount
cancel during parallel preparation records immediately; reopen ignores stale progress and stale module
page leave aborts preparation download and prevents late mount
same-turn double failure preserves first download rejection and its matching phase
same-turn double failure preserves first module rejection and its matching phase
